scope: Hike dequant/add-bias bridge primitives only; no full model inference

cases.name: E4M3FN finite boundaries and signed zero are scaled in Hike
bias addition is real f32 and preserves caller buffers
overflow never publishes nonfinite output and next call recovers
full 81920-code buffers use fixed workspace and owned output
WASM input bytes are snapshotted before asynchronous hash/compile
WASM hash mismatch refuses execution without fallback
dispose is idempotent and refuses both computations
